body.message:
We hope you are well.

We have received a complaint from the building security regarding excessive noise from the apartment. Please be advised that loud music, parties, or any disturbance caused to the neighbours are strictly prohibited as per the building regulations.

Kindly note that any violation of these rules may result in a penalty of AED 2,000

We kindly request your cooperation in keeping noise levels to a minimum and ensuring a peaceful environment for all residents and guests within the building.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
